entities.summary: Qing, a notable figure in the history of Mongolia, associated with Mongolia under Qing Rule (1636–1759). Preceded by Manchu Conquest and Dzungar Wars. Their legacy influenced Khalkha Mongols submit to the Qing to escape Dzungar aggression and Qing-Era Monasticism and Decline.
